comments: 0b763658: Get date/time for the event.
fe03e338: If the event date/time is earlier than the admission date/time, reset it to the admission date/time and display a warning message.
78b821e5: If the event date/time is later than the discharge date/time, reset it to the discharge date/time and display a warning message.
ead107c3: Set the discharge date to 'L' (Last admission) if the admission type is 'Movement'.
85487272: If the admission type is not 'Movement', set the discharge date to either the transfer date (if it has a time component) or the transfer date with a default time of 2400 (midnight).
d6d39761: If the source of admission is from a transfer, call the IN5^VADPT routine to retrieve patient information.

369012d1: If the patient movement instruction array contains a value for the 5th element (corresponding to the treating specialty), set the default response in the DIR array with the name of that specialty.

124d1aae: Prompt the user to select a treating specialty code from file #393, field .05. If the user enters an up-arrow or times out, quit. Otherwise, store the selected code in DGJTWD and retrieve the associated ward location from the WARD LOCATION file (#42) in DGJTWD1. Clear the default response in DIR("B") after the prompt.
1f8ed0bb: Set the default value for the prompt to the second piece of VAIP(8) if VAIP(8) is defined and has a value.
691d3c2c: Prompt the user with the CLINIC file (file #393, field .07), store the response in DGJTSP, and exit if the user enters an up-arrow or times out.
46af48b4: If the corresponding entry in the TREATING SPECIALTY file (#42) does not exist, set DGJTSV to the eighth piece of the entry in the Hospital Service file (#44.5) for the current hospital.
c8a04fe1: If the corresponding entry in the TREATING SPECIALTY file (#42) exists, set DGJTSV to the third piece of that entry.

3decbf57: If DGJTSV is blank, set it to 0. Then, set DGJTSV to 12 if it was 0, or to the IEN of the entry in the CLINIC DEFINITIONS file (#393.1) whose CODE field matches DGJTSV if such an entry exists, or to null if no such entry exists. If DGJTSV is not null, set DGJTSV and the default value for the prompt to the first piece of the entry in the CLINIC DEFINITIONS file (#393.1) whose IEN is DGJTSV.
